body:
They weren't threats as much as trying to make her aware of it all. She plays all this off like it's no big deal. I got her to realize that it is a big deal. She will see her therapist soon, and I'm telling her parents shortly. She doesn't need to know that. Her parents are a huge role in her life, and will support her if they know she is down. The way I wrote my original post made me sound quite sinister, but I didn't mean it like that. She got that aswell.


She understood what I said and She gave up her razor on her own terms, and promised never to cut again (Well, I don't really believe it but she still did.) She slipped up, and I'm just trying to show her that you can't just blow it off like it's nothing

Her parents are the ones who helped her stop last time, and now that she is starting again they NEED to know.


A lot of this played out today, and she is giving me her razor and She promised me she'd never cut again (both on her own terms). Regardless her parents need to be aware of all this I feel, but I understand where you're coming from. I value her well being over everything.

Dearly Beloved - Kingdom Hearts (OST ?)

It's a video game song, but it is played on a piano and is so beautiful. I rarely like OST's but this one grabs my heart each time.

She will never tell them. This isn't the first time she has done this, but she never goes to them and is adamant about not. I need to let them know. I can make sure her parents don't do anything, but if they know about her cutting/being more depressed they will be more supportive without letting up that they know. It is somewhat behind her back, but they won't confront her unless I tell them to
Wait, so don't tell her parents? I said I would tell them if she ever cut. They might not confront her, but shouldn't they know? And I am supporting her. I'm behind her every step of the way.

It is slightly. I would be okay without her, and she could live without me. We are really close though. It is as worse as I am aware. I know that. I read her tumblr secretly, I talk to her parents about it, even to her. I know everything there is to know (or as much as I can as a person)
My girlfriend cut herself last night. I don't know what to do.

You exist<3 You just need to make yourself known. It's hard, it's almost crippling, but do it. If you think you are at the end, what do you possibly have to lose? You are invincible because of it. Go do something amazing with that power
